name: 記号と文字で選ぶ設備条件チップ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH01-0079 記号と文字で選ぶ設備条件チップ. Input1 ORIGINAL is selected Wifi pill, authority for icon anatomy/proportions, optical stroke weight and selected state. Input2 native mock supplies Japanese text.
Draw ONE compact white#FFFFFF pill chip with selected forestgreen#1F6444 outline, noticeably stronger than ordinary neutral1px outline (about2logicalpx). White interior, no broad mint fill. Left original wireless glyph: THREE thin curved nested arcs over a small HOLLOW OUTLINED CIRCLE at bottom, not a filled dot, only2arcs, antenna or generic radio waves. Preserve exact original line lengths/spacing and open-circle center. Source wireless glyph optical size/stroke weight; green selected icon. To right exact Japanese "無線通信", Meiryo REGULAR40014/24-equivalent tracking0 in green#1F6444, not bold/semibold. Comfortable icon-text gap, text and icon centered vertically with equal balanced horizontal padding.
Match compact source pill proportions, full rounded ends; only modest white outer margins, no enclosing card, title, extra chips, checkmark, count or shadow. Selected state indicated by stronger border, without inventing selected check glyph. Static raster candidate; toggle/keyboard/focus behavior unverified.
reviewNotes: Selected white/green wireless pill and hollow circle present, but glyph reduced to only two arcs, text became Bold rather than Regular, and icon/border strokes too heavy. Source anatomy/type fidelity unresolved; raster candidate only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
